review_evidence: README states that the project ports DELPH-IN/PyDelphin to Lean in support of MRS-Logic.

Mrs/Basic.lean explicitly links its data structure to the DELPH-IN MRS RFC and defines Var, Constraint, Elementary Predication (EP), and MRS with top/index/predication/constraint fields; Mrs/PWL.lean adds a HOLTerm representation and MRS-to-HOL conversion interface.

A complete scan of 11 Lean files found 63 declaration-style items. Although it currently has no theorem declarations, the domain semantic structures and conversion interfaces are themselves reusable formal semantics/specification prior art under the corpus invariant.
summary: Reviewed delphin and retain its formal Lean representation of Minimal Recursion Semantics and related semantic structures.
